name: Kahontakwas Diane Longboat
reason: No own website, published email or contact form found: two web searches (4 Nov 2026) found only third-party profiles and talks (WECAN, Rotary Toronto, CAMH and University of Toronto pages, podcasts; humanitysteam.org is off limits and wasn't opened). Soul of the Mother, the teaching and healing lodge she founded at Six Nations of the Grand River in 1994, has no site of its own in the results. Much of her public role is also as an Elder in Indigenous health settings (CAMH), which would need a health-rule check.
